name: Goi ca trich
summary: Raw herring tossed with mint, onion, shredded coconut, and crisp vegetables, rolled in rice paper and dipped in fish sauce with garlic, chili, and roasted peanuts. It tastes aromatic and fresh, a salad for a hot day.
taste: Aromatic and fresh. The dip is fish sauce, chopped garlic and chili, and roasted peanuts. The salad is also named without the coconut or the dip.
howToEat: Wrap a little herring, herbs, and vegetables in rice paper, then dip it.
Eat it at any time of day, or for lunch or dinner by the water.
seoTitle: Goi ca trich — raw herring salad on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Gỏi cá trích is raw herring with mint, coconut, and crisp vegetables, rolled in rice paper with a fish-sauce and peanut dip.
